propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) so their trend accrues across CI runs.
The snapshot file must live at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (a git-tracked location) not under /reports/ (gitignored), to ensure the series is committed and synced.
The .gitignore must include a negation line !.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson to surgically un-ignore the snapshot file despite the blanket .rebar/* rule.
write_snapshot(dict) appends a timestamped record; read_snapshots(since,until) yields filtered in-range records and gracefully skips malformed lines without raising.
Metrics are unavailable until a snapshot exists; the implementation is append-only and additive to avoid overwriting prior history.
